new_rows.control_detail: Three plants through the identical extraction+sweep glue (R42 X1 rule: keys are this lane's own derived streams): known English-register plaintexts encrypted at pre-registered cells (P1 blob1033:div9 fwd vig- rot77 L240; P2 comb:decpref:blob761:xor rev beaufort rot201 L200; P3 blob3301:nib fwd vig+atbash rot500 L240). All three recovered byte-exactly at the planted cell as grid-best, non-degenerate, pmax 38.32/33.40/32.32 vs bars 18.826/14.034/18.826.
new_rows.hypothesis: One of the three onion pre-page 256-byte hex blobs (markers 761/1033/3301; extraction shas 05acf0d8/d8c0f83c/4f1cef87, re-extracted by this lane's own glue and digest-matched to R43-F6), or that blob joined byte-wise with the pp49-51 payload, is a repeating mod-29 keystream for the 55 unsolved LP2 pages - the F3-J6 join X0 item 31 found never run.
new_rows.result: NEGATIVE (measured, panel-R36). 27 derived keystreams (3 blobs x {byte mod 29, byte div 9, interleaved hi/lo nibbles} + {canon_256, canon_256_decpref} x 3 blobs x {XOR, ADD, SUB(canon-blob) mod 256} reduced mod 29) x {fwd, rev} x 6 configs (vig+/-, Beaufort, each +/- atbash) x all rotations (256 or 512) = 92,160 decodes/page over 55 unsolved pages = 5,068,800 decodes. 0 crossers; 0 mod-29 key collisions (family size exact); observed global best pmax 5.881 (page 14, blob3301:nib fwd vig+atbash rot337, L=137, preg EN_HALFVOWEL, ioc_n 1.027, mds 16, non-degenerate) vs its bar 14.034 - 8.2z below bar; per-page best pmax range 4.48-5.88, no near-miss anywhere.
new_rows.coverage: All 3 pre-page blobs under 3 byte->mod-29 reductions + all 18 canon-payload byte-wise joins under mod-29, both key directions, all whole-period rotations, 6 periodic substitution configs, every unsolved page; panel-max over 12 registers (panel-R36); R3 statistics persisted for every per-page best (p4_results.json).
new_rows.threshold: bars_v3.bar_v3(92160, L_cap, 'free') with L_cap = largest of {120,240,400,729} <= page length, floor 120: 14.0340 (L_cap 120), 18.8261 (L_cap 240; max page length 277). Crosses iff a non-degenerate full-adjudicate pmax >= bar; named in PREREG.md before any run (incl. a pre-data correction of a grid-arithmetic slip, documented in the PREREG itself).

three_conditionals.key_space: the three onion pre-page 256-byte blobs under byte mod 29 / byte div 9 / interleaved-nibble reductions, plus the 18 {canon_256, canon_256_decpref} x blob x {XOR, ADD, SUB(canon-blob)} byte-joins under mod 29 only; x {fwd, rev} x all rotations. NOT: other reductions, blob-minus-canon SUB, div9/nib reductions of the joins, cross-blob joins, hash/PRF expansions of the blobs
three_conditionals.transition_model: periodic (repeating, constant per-page phase) additive/Beaufort substitution mod 29 x atbash pre-composition - no autokey, no per-line/per-page resets, no skips or rejection rules, no one-shot alignment, no transposition
three_conditionals.adjudicator_register: panel-R36, panel-max over 12 registers (adjudicate/adjudicate_batch); free-null bar bars_v3 'free' (R37 caveat: free control at L=240 fails for OE and EN_HALFVOWEL)

new_rows.not_covered: Reductions beyond the three pre-registered maps; the joined streams under div9/nib reductions; SUB in the blob-minus-canon direction; blob-x-blob joins; blobs as autokey seeds, offset/permutation tables, or PRF/KDF inputs; per-line or per-page key resets (R44 lane R1's axis); languages outside the 12-register panel. The F3 Section 4 aggregate constraint (any blind additive keystream excluded at 17-sigma by the book-wide doublet rate) independently bounds this family and is consistent with this per-page direct negative.
new_rows.reopens_if: A measured fact ties a specific blob to a specific page subset (e.g. a provenance link between an onion pre-page and particular LP2 pages), motivating per-page offset schedules or reset models this grid cannot represent; or a fourth pre-page blob surfaces.
